failures.content: A smaller draft model rapidly generates multiple candidate tokens to propose a sequence of future outputs. The larger target model then verifies these candidates in a single parallel pass, accepting the longest prefix that matches its own predictions. This process significantly increases throughput by reducing the number of sequential target-model steps required, while ensuring the final output is identical to what the target model would have produced alone.
